newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

PARANAGUA: Vessels: Perciles SG loading 55,000 tonnes mixed cargo (soybeans/eal). General Vladimir Zain loading 20,600 tonnes soymeal. Alpheos loading 49,000 tonnes soymeal. Axion 1 loading 55,000 soybeans. Sea Harmony loading 25,000 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, nine vessels for soymeal, seven for soybeans and one for mixed cargo (soybeans/meal). Road: 1,032 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on April 29, 346 trucks with soymeal and 35 with vegetable oils, including soyoil.

Vessels: Alpha Gemini loading 56,700 tonnes soybeans. Waiting to dock, Glory Hope to load 53,000 tonnes soybeans and Captain Giorgis I to load 55,000 tonnes soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Ignace Daszynsky loading 10,000 tonnes soymeal.
Road: 485 trucks carrying 12,798 tonnes soybeans arrived on April 29, as well as eight trucks carrying 214 tonnes soymeal.
Rail: 123 wagons arrived carrying 7,399 tonnes soybeans.
